findings.title: Nasser Hospital operating rooms, radiology, laboratory and surgical inpatient departments confirmed suspended after November 12 strike
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Surgical and diagnostic care for an approximately one-million-person hospital catchment, including displaced patients
findings.summary: Hospital director Ahmed Al-Farra told Le Monde that Nasser Hospital's Al-Yasin building surgical operating rooms, imaging/radiology, laboratories and surgical inpatient facilities have ceased activity following the November 12 strike; the closure remains in effect on November 13. This is a newly documented specificity of an already recorded hospital attack, not a newly occurring strike.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: operating rooms, radiology departments, laboratories and surgical inpatient units – all of which have now ceased activity
findings.source_type: Established reporting with direct hospital director and staff interviews

bounded_discovery_context.independent_corrob: AP November 12 reported suspended surgeries and services, but this source newly specifies the affected departments and duration
